name: content_safety_guard
description: Port of ole-eval code/qwen_vm/app_scenarios/content_safety_guard. Ordered policy: hard BLOCK reasons (prohibited / PII-public / age / context / severity>=90) first, then REVIEW reasons, then ALLOW. The Python taxonomy table lookups (base_severity per semantic, audience age) are folded into direct model judgments on the choice questions.

is_prohibited.instructions: Does the content hit a prohibited semantic category (never allowed in any context)?

pii_public_high.instructions: Does this expose high-severity PII on a public feed (base_severity >= 80)?

criteria.A: no PII exposure on public feed
criteria.B: yes, high-severity PII on a public feed

pii_public_low.instructions: Does this expose low/mid-severity PII on a public feed (base_severity < 80)?

criteria.B: yes, low/mid PII on a public feed

age_blocking.instructions: Does any semantic exceed the audience minimum age at blocking severity (>= 80)?

age_review.instructions: Does any semantic exceed the audience minimum age at review severity (< 80)?

context_blocking.instructions: Is any semantic not allowed in this context at blocking severity (>= 75)?

context_review.instructions: Is any semantic not allowed in this context at review severity (< 75)?

effective_severity.instructions: Effective severity 0-100 (base taxonomy severity plus repeat-violation boost up to +30).
